record.question: Because light travels faster than sound, lightning appears to __________ thunder.
record.explanation: Answer D: precede. Lightning appears before thunder; “precede” is the correct verb. Independent check: Lightning is seen before thunder is heard because light travels faster; “precede” means come before. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/precede. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
